statement: Nebius lists on-demand GPU rental rates rising effective October 1, 2026: H100 from $3.85 to $4.50 per GPU-hour, H200 $4.50 to $5.40, B200 $7.15 to $8.50, and B300 $7.85 to $9.50.
why: Published rental rates are the most direct public read on how tight deployed GPU capacity is relative to customer demand.

impact.mechanism: Rental price is a display overlay only: it shows the level and direction of neocloud GPU pricing without itself scoring demand or supply.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own public price page, treated as secondary rather than a filing; the prior-hike history is cross-referenced only via search, not a separately fetched document.

dispersion: On-demand $4.50 (H100) to $9.50 (B300) per GPU-hour from October 1; preemptible from $0.79 (H100/H200) to $0.99 (B200/B300).
